ok.description: True if the BrepPhylo run finished successfully.

trees.description: One Newick tree per clone, aligned with annotations and clones.clone_id.

phylogeny.description: Per-clone PNG plots as plain base64-encoded blobs (no 'data:image/png;base64,' prefix; may contain null for clones without a figure).

phylogeny_pdf.description: Per-clone PDF plots as base64 blobs (may contain null).

annotations.description: Per-clone list of per-sequence annotation objects.

items.description: Original input row plus a 'label' field.

clones.description: Lightweight per-clone summary aligned with trees and annotations.

tree_type_requested.description: Tree builder requested by the user (tree_type parameter).

tree_type.description: Effective tree builder actually used (may differ from requested when IgPhyML falls back to dnapars).

which_clones.description: Clone IDs explicitly included, if any.

ignore_clones.description: Clone IDs explicitly excluded, if any.

germline_set.description: Germline set identifier or path passed to BrepPhylo.

class_unknown_value.description: Value used to fill empty/NA entries in the class column (typically 'unknown').

class_unknown_replaced_in_input.description: Number of empty/NA class values replaced by class_unknown_value.

class_n_states.description: Number of distinct class values after preprocessing.

class_states_capped.description: True if the number of class values exceeded max_class_categories and colouring was disabled.

max_class_categories.description: Maximum allowed number of distinct class values for colouring.

filters_applied.description: True if sequence text filters were applied.

uppercased_rows.description: Number of rows whose sequence values were changed to uppercase.

gap_rows_touched.description: Number of rows whose sequences contained gaps (according to gap_policy).

noniupac_rows_touched.description: Number of rows whose sequences contained non-IUPAC characters (according to noniupac_policy).

gap_policy.description: Gap policy used when filters_applied = true.

noniupac_policy.description: Non-IUPAC policy used when filters_applied = true.

ig_stop_policy.description: Policy used to handle stop codons / out-of-frame sequences for IgPhyML.

igphyml_stop_rows.description: Number of sequences flagged as containing stop codons in IgPhyML preflight.

igphyml_frame_rows.description: Number of sequences flagged as out-of-frame in IgPhyML preflight.

igphyml_fallback_to_dnapars.description: True if IgPhyML was requested but execution fell back to dnapars due to stop/frame policy.

artifact_zip_b64.description: Additional BrepPhylo output files bundled as compressed archives.

clone_bundle_zip.description: Single ZIP containing all BrepPhylo output files (per-clone folders, alignment PDFs, logs, etc.) except the main clone_*.tree and clone_*.png/clone_*.pdf that are returned separately. Base64-encoded.

warnings.description: Human-readable warning messages (e.g. dropped rows, missing columns, caps on colouring).

logs.description: Pipeline step logs, including raw stdout from BrepPhylo::cloneLineage and high-level step summaries.

render.description: Hint for the frontend renderer; for BrepPhylo this is 'phylogeny'.

error.description: Error message when ok = false; null on success.
